cases.purpose: A read-only target file (EACCES as uid 2000) gives 'cannot open ... for writing' and leaves every file unchanged
cases.oracle: Documented uclampset --system contract (open all changed files before the first write, raise the ceiling first when the new floor exceeds it, roll back in reverse order, short write is EIO), a private BASHOS_PROC_ROOT tree and a seccomp-notify syscall log (helpers/system-sequence.py)
cases.comparison: Diagnostic text, unchanged file values and the absence of any write for a read-only ceiling and a read-only floor.
cases.script:
[[ $UID == 2000 && $EUID == 2000 && $PWD == /tmp/parity-case && $HOME == /tmp/parity-home ]] || exit 125
IFS= read -r marker </etc/bashos-parity-vm || exit 125
IFS= read -r vendor </sys/class/dmi/id/sys_vendor || exit 125
[[ $vendor == QEMU && $marker =~ ^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$ ]] || exit 125
[[ $(type -t uclampset) == builtin ]] || exit 125
SEQ=/opt/bashos-parity/harness/helpers/system-sequence.py
P=/tmp/parity-case/proc/sys/kernel
mkproc() { /usr/bin/rm -rf /tmp/parity-case/proc; /usr/bin/mkdir -p "$P"; printf '32\n' >"$P/sched_util_clamp_min"; printf '512\n' >"$P/sched_util_clamp_max"; }
# run LABEL "SEQ-RULES" "COMMAND" ; prints status, stderr probes, file values and the ordered open/write trace
run() {
  local T=$HOME/$1 rules=$2 cmd=$3
  /usr/bin/rm -f "$T".log "$T".err "$T".rc
  BASHOS_PROC_ROOT=/tmp/parity-case/proc /usr/bin/python3 "$SEQ" --notify openat --log-string openat=1 --notify write --log-args write=0,2 --log-mem write=1:4 $rules --log "$T.log" -- "$BASH" --noprofile --norc -c "$cmd 2>$T.err; printf 'rc=%s\\n' \$? >$T.rc"
  local rc=$(<"$T.rc") mn mx; read -r mn <"$P/sched_util_clamp_min"; read -r mx <"$P/sched_util_clamp_max"
  echo "$1: ${rc} min=$mn max=$mx"
  /usr/bin/python3 -I - "$T" <<'PY'
import json, re, sys
t = sys.argv[1]
ev = []
for l in open(t + ".log"):
    r = json.loads(l)
    if r["syscall"] == "openat":
        s = str(r.get("string1", ""))
        if "sched_util_clamp_" in s:
            ev.append("open " + s.rsplit("_", 1)[1])
    elif r["syscall"] == "write":
        data = bytes.fromhex(r["memory1"]["hex"])[:r["arg2"]]
        if re.fullmatch(rb"[0-9]+\n", data):
            ev.append("write %s%s" % (data.decode().strip(), "" if r["reply"] == "continue" else "[" + r["reply"] + "]"))
print("  trace: " + (" | ".join(ev) or "(none)"))
err = open(t + ".err").read().strip().splitlines()
for line in err:
    print("  err: " + line.replace("/tmp/parity-case/proc/sys/kernel/", "P/"))
PY
}
mkproc; /usr/bin/chmod 444 "$P/sched_util_clamp_max"
run omax "" "uclampset -m 64 -M 768 --system"
mkproc; /usr/bin/chmod 444 "$P/sched_util_clamp_min"
run omin "" "uclampset -m 64 -M 768 --system"
cases.stdout:
omax: rc=1 min=32 max=512
  trace: open min | open max | open min | open max
  err: uclampset: cannot open P/sched_util_clamp_max for writing: Permission denied
omin: rc=1 min=32 max=512
  trace: open min | open max | open min
  err: uclampset: cannot open P/sched_util_clamp_min for writing: Permission denied

cases.purpose: Evidence for the r5 blocker: the guest kernel has no scheduler clamp sysctls, so live --system semantics cannot be exercised
cases.oracle: util-linux uclampset (guest) and the filesystem under /proc/sys/kernel
cases.comparison: Existence of the live sysctl files, and candidate and util-linux behavior on the live system path.
cases.script:
[[ $UID == 2000 && $EUID == 2000 && $PWD == /tmp/parity-case && $HOME == /tmp/parity-home ]] || exit 125
IFS= read -r marker </etc/bashos-parity-vm || exit 125
IFS= read -r vendor </sys/class/dmi/id/sys_vendor || exit 125
[[ $vendor == QEMU && $marker =~ ^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$ ]] || exit 125
[[ $(type -t uclampset) == builtin ]] || exit 125
SEQ=/opt/bashos-parity/harness/helpers/system-sequence.py
P=/tmp/parity-case/proc/sys/kernel
mkproc() { /usr/bin/rm -rf /tmp/parity-case/proc; /usr/bin/mkdir -p "$P"; printf '32\n' >"$P/sched_util_clamp_min"; printf '512\n' >"$P/sched_util_clamp_max"; }
[[ -e /proc/sys/kernel/sched_util_clamp_min ]]; a=$?
[[ -e /proc/sys/kernel/sched_util_clamp_max ]]; b=$?
echo "live-min-exists=$((a==0)) live-max-exists=$((b==0))"
out=$(uclampset --system 2>&1); echo "candidate rc=$? text=$([[ $out == *"cannot read /proc/sys/kernel/sched_util_clamp_min: No such file or directory"* ]] && echo 1 || echo 0)"
/usr/bin/uclampset --system >/dev/null 2>&1; echo "util-linux rc-nonzero=$(( $? != 0 ))"
cases.stdout:
live-min-exists=0 live-max-exists=0
candidate rc=1 text=1
util-linux rc-nonzero=1
